messages:
marta: Quick sync — putting together a benchmark narrative that leans on a 'speed-to-price tilt' framing. Need a hero chart + two supporting visuals + clear inbound routing for leads. Pinged folks below. Timeline: draft deck by Thu, webinar next Tue.

sam: Tilt framing sounds fresh. Let's avoid the tired 'latency-cost' label — use 'speed-to-price' in copy. :nerd_face:

alex: On numbers. Which workloads exactly? chat completions ~256 tokens (prod mix), embeddings sampling 1024 dim. I'll run the combos: hosted, dedicated, quantized variants. Will post a CSV.

liv: Visuals idea: 3-panel layout — 1) hero tilt chart (median latency on X vs cost-per-1k tokens on Y) with a diagonal 'sweet spot' band, 2) fat-tail inset (median vs p95 deciles), 3) throughput bar for GPU types. Minimal copy overlays.

noah: Inbound routing rules suggestion: if lead_estimated_ARR > $10k -> sales SDR A. If lead indicates 'bench' or 'proof-of-concept' -> Solutions Eng queue. If request contains 'private' or 'VPC' -> Enterprise AE + Security contact. Also tag leads that choose 'dedicated' or >10k qps.

marta: Good rules. Alex — can you surface median, p95, cost/1k, and throughput numbers so Liv can mock charts? Also would love a quick code snippet to generate the tilt plot for the deck.

alex: Sure — posting a quick sketched script:
```python
# toy example to make tilt plot
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
df = pd.read_csv('bench_summary.csv')
plt.scatter(df['median_ms'], df['cost_per_1k'], s=60)
# annotate hosted/dedicated/quantized
for i,r in df.iterrows():
    plt.text(r['median_ms']*1.02, r['cost_per_1k']*0.98, r['variant'])
plt.xscale('log')
plt.xlabel('Median latency (ms)')
plt.ylabel('Cost per 1k tokens ($)')
plt.title('Speed-to-price tilt')
plt.savefig('tilt_hero.png', dpi=150)
```

bench-bot: Bench run finished for dataset "microchat-2026-03". Summary: median latencies (ms) -> hosted 120, dedicated 45, quantized 60. cost/1k tokens -> hosted $0.12, dedicated $0.08, quantized $0.05. throughput (tokens/s per GPU) -> hosted 8k, dedicated 28k, quantized 22k. CSV attached: /bench/microchat-2026-03/summary.csv

liv: Those numbers are great — I'll mock the tilt and the fat-tail inset, send PNGs shortly. For hero copy, thinking: "Pick the right speed-to-price balance for your product".

sam: Webinar hook draft: 1) Why 'speed-to-price' matters — real customer tradeoffs, 2) How routing + quantization moves the needle without breaking SLAs, 3) Live Q&A + quick demo. Aim for 20 min + 10 Q&A.

marta: Excellent. Action items: Alex -> final numbers + CSV link (EOD). Liv -> first mock images (tomorrow morning). Noah -> draft lead routing config to hand to RevOps. Sam -> webinar bullets + slide flow. I'll book a 20-min sync for tomorrow. Thanks! :rocket:
